purpose: Blind manual reference for one genuine invoice, written from the printed document before any OCR or model output is seen.
rules: Record only what is printed. Never compute a missing value and present it as printed.
Every monetary field carries provenance: printed, absent (not on the document) or illegible (present but unreadable).
An absent field and an illegible field are different states and must never be merged.
Do not normalise a printed inconsistency: if quantity x unit_price does not equal the printed line total, record both and describe the discrepancy.
Shipping, discounts and tax are recorded separately and are never product rows.
Two annotators must resolve any disagreement before the evaluation runs; record the resolution.
The reference and the image hash are frozen before the pipeline is run.
